subject: general
question: Rohini Bhate, recipient of Kalidas Samman was associated with which classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Nrityabharati Kathak Dance Academy was founded by Kathak dancer Rohini Bhate in 1947. 
 
• Rohini Bhate was a Bharatnatyam and Kathak dancer. She was born in Patna and went to school in Pune.
 
• She advised Khairagarh University and Lalit Kala Kendra, University of Pune, on the teaching of kathak and other dance forms.
 
• She received the Kalidas Samman and the Maharashtra Rajya Puraskar in 1977, the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1979, and the Maharashtra Gaurav Puraskar in 1990.
 
• She became a Fellow of the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2006 and received the Akademi Ratna Award in 2007.
